recipe.title: Israeli couscous
recipe.notes: One that Raewyn makes regularly - goes well with chicken or lamb.

method.s: Bring a large pot of salted water or stock to the boil.
Add Israeli couscous and simmer for 7-8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain.
Stir through olive oil and season to taste.
Add herbs, pine nuts and lemon zest.
